moments.title: Jamie Miller Tops UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Welsh singer Jamie Miller has made history by reaching Number 1 on the UK Official Singles Chart with his track 'Babydoll', the first Welsh male artist to do so in 41 years.

angles.copy: Massive congratulations to Welsh sensation Jamie Miller, who's officially clinched the UK Number 1 spot with 'Babydoll'! A huge moment for Welsh music. #JamieMiller
